description: Get the full profile of one camp: description, organizer, parent rating, and its sessions with dates, the camp's listed prices (US dollars, price_usd_min/max), registration_status, bookability and booking_mode (native | platform_deeplink | listing_only; platform_deeplink sessions carry the platform's registration_url and reported availability_status). Sessions bookable on kiddinglab.com also carry parent_price_usd — the price the parent pays before tax, including Kiddinglab's 1.5% service fee (service_fee_usd). Sessions from the last 12 months are included — check session_status (ended/in_progress/upcoming) before recommending. data_freshness says how recently the listing was verified. Use the camp_id returned by search_camps.
name: get_camp_details
title: Get camp details
